opening.argument: The video presents a working AVAX flash-loan arbitrage method while directing viewers to fund and operate a contract. Its instructions say, "Send $200 of Avalanche/AVAX to the contract for gas fee for all swaps" and then "Call ‘flashloan’ function in Remix." The speaker describes sending 11.23 AVAX and reports receiving 99.499 AVAX, calling the result "at least 5X" and approximately "7X." Those concrete directions and claimed returns support the promoted opportunity, while the disclaimer, "This worked for me. But TRY IT AT YOUR OWN RISK," does not establish that the returns are genuine, repeatable, recoverable by viewers, or controlled by the demonstrated contract.
